preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: output == 'YES' -> len(second_line) == len(s) and all(second_line[i-1] == second_line[i*j-1] for i in range(1, len(s)+1) for j in range(1, len(s)//i+1) if i*j <= len(s))
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', then the second line contains a permutation of the characters in s that satisfies the condition for all prime numbers p <= |s| and for all integers i ranging from 1 to |s| / p.
